flavor.text: The skin on its face is impervious to attack, but breathing difficulties made this Pokémon go extinct anyway.
Though it’s able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.

abilities.name: Water Absorb
abilities.description: If hit by a Water-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.

abilities.name: Ice Body
abilities.description: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in snow.

abilities.name: Slush Rush
abilities.description: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in snow.
